purpose: Teach: 打ち切り/有価/作り上げる/使い捨て/版元/レスポンス/率先/囲む

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、芽の出ない研究の打ち切りも勇気だ
lines.en: Ren — sometimes the courage is knowing when to stop a research project that isn't bearing fruit.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Slight pause before the key phrase. A mentor's certainty, not a lecture. Eye contact held. The weight of experience in the silence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費を有価証券で運用する案も考えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll also explore possibilities for research fund allocation.
lines.style: Quick, respectful acknowledgment. Slight formality in posture — sitting straighter. Eager to show he's absorbing the lesson. Breath held, like he's thinking already.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室で新理論を作り上げる気概を持て
lines.en: Ren — bring real ambition to your lab work. Create something new.
lines.style: Firmer now. The word 'ambition' lands with quiet conviction. Not harsh — pushing. Leaning forward slightly, as if passing something tangible across the desk.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験器具の使い捨てを減らします
lines.en: Yes. I'll set up the research environment more carefully — reduce waste in our equipment use.
lines.style: Polite, almost formal. A beat slower than before, as if turning the instruction over in his mind. Genuine, not rehearsed. Nods slightly while speaking.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の版元と直接交渉しろ
lines.en: Ren — negotiate directly with the journal publishers yourself. Don't delegate that.
lines.style: Sharp, decisive. The word 'yourself' carries weight. Shorter sentences. A command wrapped in mentorship. Sits back slightly — this one is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。被験者のレスポンスを丁寧に集めます
lines.en: Understood. I'll collect subject responses thoroughly and with care.
lines.style: Quieter now, more careful. The kind of attentiveness that shows he's really listening. Fingers unconsciously tightening on his notepad. Respectful but not servile.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、率先して研究を引っ張れ
lines.en: Ren — step up. Lead this research. Pull the team forward.
lines.style: Direct, stripped of softness. Three short sentences. Each one its own beat. A challenge delivered with belief that he can do it. Held gaze, no looking away.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究テーブルを参考書で囲む環境を作ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll create an environment around the research table — reference materials, resources — something to work within.
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate. Processing the larger directive. The finality of a closing statement — quieter on the trailing phrases. A sense of commitment settling in, not rushed.
